title: SMS Delivery Failures from Twilio to Telemat Cel Brazil
impact_summary: SMS delivery to Telemat Cel network subscribers in Brazil has experienced failures, though recovery is underway.
backbase_rationale: Backbase services remain unaffected; monitoring the situation is adequate.

title: SMS Delivery Delays from Twilio to Free Caraibe Martinique
impact_summary: Twilio customers may be experiencing SMS delivery delays from Twilio to Free Caraibe network subscribers in Martinique. Our team has identified the cause, and is working to resolve the issue. We will provide another update in 1 hour or as soon as more information becomes available.
backbase_rationale: The delays could impact timely message delivery for Backbase clients.

title: Update to SendGrid Domain Authentication: Send to Coworker Action Removed
impact_summary: The removal of the Send to Coworker action changes the domain authentication workflow, requiring users to communicate DNS record updates via internal channels.
backbase_rationale: Removing the action simplifies the process and enhances security by reducing risk of DNS misconfiguration.

title: Jumio Android SDK v4.18.0
impact_summary: Increased minSdkVersion to 24, dropping support for devices below Android Nougat.
backbase_rationale: Backbase must ensure its Android app targets API 24+ to use the updated SDK.

title: Jumio Android SDK v4.14.0
impact_summary: Added WCAG 2.2 AA and EAA accessibility compliance and eIDAS Digital Identity support for selected countries.
backbase_rationale: Backbase must verify its app meets WCAG 2.2 AA standards and eIDAS requirements where applicable.

title: SMS Delivery Delays from Twilio to Free Caraibe France
impact_summary: SMS deliveries to Free Caraibe France subscribers have recovered but are being monitored.
backbase_rationale: SMS to Free Caraibe France is used for account verification; monitoring ensures stability.

title: SMS Delivery Failures from Twilio to Lycamobile United Kingdom
impact_summary: SMS delivery failures are being observed for Lycamobile subscribers in the United Kingdom.
backbase_rationale: Monitoring to detect any potential impact on our services.

title: SMS Delivery Delays and Failures from Twilio Phone Numbers to Claro Brazil
impact_summary: SMS deliveries to Claro Brazil subscribers are delayed and failing.
backbase_rationale: SMS communications are critical for Backbase notifications.

title: 1Console Login Unavailable
impact_summary: Login failures prevent customers from accessing their Twilio Console accounts.
backbase_rationale: Backbase services depend on Twilio Console for user authentication.
